name: Seitokai no Ichizon - DS Suru Seitokai
original_name: 生徒会の一存 -DSする生徒会-
source:
You take control of Sugisaki Ken, the sole male member of Hekiyou Academy's student council. Your mission is to make the rest of the student council members his harem by Christmas Day by improving popularity for nine months from April to December. 

[From Himeya Shop]
